identity.name: Elegance Collection Spring Drive

case.bezel: none — dress case, curved Zaratsu-polished sides

identity.one_liner: A manual-wind Spring Drive dress watch with an ice-blue textured dial referencing omiwatari, the ridge that forms on frozen Lake Suwa each winter.

narrative.story: The SBGY007 runs caliber 9R31, a hand-wound Spring Drive movement with a dual mainspring barrel giving roughly 72 hours of power reserve and accuracy within 15 seconds a month. Grand Seiko introduced it in 2021 as part of the Elegance Collection's Seasons line, with a dial textured after omiwatari — the ice ridge that forms across frozen Lake Suwa in winter, historically read by Shinto priests as an omen. At 38.5mm with a 10.2mm case thickness, it wears smaller and thinner than most Spring Drive references.
narrative.collector_notes: Splash-resistant only rather than fully water-resistant, in keeping with its dress-watch build; buyers should treat it accordingly rather than as an everyday-wear piece.
